name: Forgot Password Block
description: Custom block to display the forgot password form.
project_description: Forgot Password Block provides a single block plugin that renders Drupal core's password-reset request form (Drupal\user\Form\UserPasswordForm, the form served at /user/password) so it can be placed in any theme region, sidebar, modal, or login area via the standard Block Layout UI. It adds no form of its own and no configuration: the block simply fetches the core form through the form builder, so it inherits core's behaviour and security wholesale, including the CSRF token, the password-reset flood control, and the generic anti-enumeration confirmation message. Depends only on the core User and Block modules.
